read_threads_reason: Highest median logical read rate at every read CTA count in the five-round standalone grid (reads phase).
unroll_points_reason: Strongest read thread count at the largest read budgets of the communication groups (100 for C=32, 64 for C=64, 128/131 for C=1) plus an intermediate 32-CTA point.
read_unroll_reason: Highest median logical read rate at every unroll point (32/64/100/128/131 x 1024). The plan criterion (<1% over two successive increases) is not met at any point; thread count and SM count are at hardware limits, so this is the strongest achieved setting, not an established saturation point.
